task_indexes.name: backfill_contract_enum_task_v2
task_indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX backfill_contract_enum_task_v2 ON astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_tasks_v2 USING btree (run_id, id) WHERE (kind = 'alpaca_option_contracts'::text)

task_indexes.name: backfill_contract_old_child_cursor_v2
task_indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX backfill_contract_old_child_cursor_v2 ON astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_tasks_v2 USING btree (run_id, created_at, id) WHERE (kind = 'alpaca_option_bars'::text)

task_indexes.name: backfill_daily_month_units_v2
task_indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX backfill_daily_month_units_v2 ON astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_tasks_v2 USING btree (run_id, ((scope ->> 'source_month'::text)), ((scope #>> '{member_ids,0}'::text[])), status) WHERE (family = 'D03'::text)

task_indexes.name: backfill_identity_derived_member_v2
task_indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX backfill_identity_derived_member_v2 ON astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_tasks_v2 USING btree (run_id, ((scope #>> '{member_ids,0}'::text[])), id) WHERE ((kind = ANY (ARRAY['derive_daily'::text, 'derive_intraday'::text])) AND (NOT (scope ? 'identity_refresh_of'::text)))

task_indexes.name: backfill_identity_refresh_tasks_v2
task_indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX backfill_identity_refresh_tasks_v2 ON astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_tasks_v2 USING btree (run_id, status) WHERE (scope ? 'identity_refresh_of'::text)

task_indexes.name: backfill_reuse_children_v2
task_indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX backfill_reuse_children_v2 ON astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_tasks_v2 USING btree (run_id, ((scope ->> 'reuse_parent'::text))) WHERE (scope ? 'reuse_parent'::text)

task_indexes.name: backfill_shared_action_tasks_v2
task_indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX backfill_shared_action_tasks_v2 ON astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_tasks_v2 USING btree (run_id, status, id) WHERE (kind = 'alpaca_actions'::text)

task_indexes.name: backfill_tasks_family_turn_v2
task_indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX backfill_tasks_family_turn_v2 ON astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_tasks_v2 USING btree (run_id, family, priority, next_retry_at, created_at, id) WHERE (status = ANY (ARRAY['PENDING'::text, 'RUNNING'::text, 'RETRY_WAIT'::text]))

task_indexes.name: backfill_tasks_family_v2
task_indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX backfill_tasks_family_v2 ON astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_tasks_v2 USING btree (run_id, family, status)

task_indexes.name: backfill_tasks_minute_alias_status_v2
task_indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX backfill_tasks_minute_alias_status_v2 ON astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_tasks_v2 USING btree (run_id, status, next_retry_at) WHERE ((family = 'P01'::text) AND (kind = ANY (ARRAY['alpaca_stock_bars'::text, 'retained_reuse'::text])) AND (COALESCE((scope ->> 'timeframe'::text), '1Min'::text) = '1Min'::text))

task_indexes.name: backfill_tasks_provider_v2
task_indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX backfill_tasks_provider_v2 ON astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_tasks_v2 USING btree (run_id, provider, status, kind)

task_indexes.name: backfill_tasks_recovery_turn_v2
task_indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX backfill_tasks_recovery_turn_v2 ON astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_tasks_v2 USING btree (run_id, family, priority, next_retry_at, created_at, id) WHERE (status = ANY (ARRAY['RETRY_WAIT'::text, 'RUNNING'::text]))

task_indexes.name: backfill_tasks_runnable_v2
task_indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX backfill_tasks_runnable_v2 ON astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_tasks_v2 USING btree (run_id, status, priority, next_retry_at, id)

task_indexes.name: backfill_tasks_runtime_summary_v2
task_indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX backfill_tasks_runtime_summary_v2 ON astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_tasks_v2 USING btree (run_id, family, kind, provider, status, records_committed, last_progress_at)

task_indexes.name: backfill_tasks_v2_pkey
task_indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX backfill_tasks_v2_pkey ON astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_tasks_v2 USING btree (id)
